name: traffic_light_controller
title: Intersection Traffic Light Controller FSM
description: An intersection traffic light controller supporting Main Street (North-South) and Side Street (East-West), featuring pedestrian crossing walk requests, an emergency vehicle preemption override, and programmable yellow/green transition timing counters.

parameters.name: MAIN_GREEN_CYCLES
parameters.description: Clock cycles Main Street stays green

parameters.name: SIDE_GREEN_CYCLES
parameters.description: Clock cycles Side Street stays green

parameters.name: YELLOW_CYCLES
parameters.description: Clock cycles yellow light is illuminated

ports.name: car_present_side
ports.description: Sensor detecting vehicle waiting on side street

ports.name: pedestrian_req
ports.description: Pushbutton request for pedestrian walk phase

ports.name: ped_walk
ports.description: Pedestrian walk signal (1 = WALK, 0 = DONT WALK)

ports.name: state_out
ports.description: Current state indicator for verification monitor

requirements: Safety Guarantee: Under NO circumstances may main_light and side_light both show Green or Yellow simultaneously.
Emergency Preemption: When emergency_override asserts, main_light must immediately force Green, side_light Red, and ped_walk 0.
State Sequence: S_MAIN_GREEN -> S_MAIN_YELLOW -> S_ALL_RED1 -> S_SIDE_GREEN -> S_SIDE_YELLOW -> S_ALL_RED2 -> S_MAIN_GREEN.
Pedestrian Servicing: If pedestrian_req was pulsed, provide a walk phase during the side green cycle and clear the latched request.
